name: Microsoft Classic IntelliMouse
notes: 79-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Microsoft Classic IntelliMouse, recorded with hid-recorder on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/a9c91ed4a89189bc548f2e45613b7710/microsoft-classic-intellimouse.hidrec. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
